BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

A little groundwork.

What should I include in a material enquiry?

Include the material type, required size or grade, estimated tonnage, delivery location, and preferred date. Add any project specifications so the requirements can be reviewed.

Can I request help choosing a material?

Yes. Choose “Help me choose” in the form and describe the intended use. Final material suitability should be confirmed against your project’s engineering specifications.

Does this form send my enquiry?

No. It creates a text file on your device. You can email the downloaded enquiry to venkatramana.vbm@gmail.com or call B. Nandakumar on +91 98422 72439.
